doc.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026

title: Producers, backstage reunion and the photograph
summary: She names Rick White and Dan Melnick as organizers and describes the backstage reunion and the group photo she skipped.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Who was in charge of assembling the combos, the combinations of people?

I think that was Rick White from Festival Productions and Dan Melnick. Yeah. Rick White was amazing. I think he’s teaching at Columbia. But yeah, it was just – and honestly you know how things like that happen. It was – it just happened. You know? And you get all those people coming together, the reunion that was happening backstage. And I remember I got this photographer, John Abbott, and I still have yet to ask him for a copy or I lost it over the years, but I asked him to do a photo of a Great Night in Harlem that night. And he got on the ledge of the first balcony and he took, there must have been a hundred of the greats. Everybody came on stage. And I didn’t go for the photo because I didn’t think I had earned that right. You know?
